Rashi on Niddah 39a:14:6.hebrew: זה וזה אסורין - אין צ"ל ט"ו שעבר שאסור, שהרי כל היום המתינה שמא תראה, דקי"ל דחייב אדם לפרוש מאשתו סמוך לוסתה. ואין צ"ל יום כ' שראתה בו, שהרי נדה היא. אלא ה"ק: כשיחזור ויגיע ט"ו, אסורה לשמש, שהרי יום וסתה הוא, ועדיין לא דילגתו אלא פעם אחת, ואין וסת נעקר בפחות מג"פ. וכשיגיע יום כ' לראייה של כ', אסורה לשמש, שמא תקבע וסת מכ' לכ', שהרי שינתה פעם אחת ליום כ'. וכן פעמים ליום כ' זה וזה אסורין: יום ט"ו ויום כ' הבא. אבל ג' פעמים ליום כ', הותר יום ט"ו ונאסר יום כ':
Rashi on Niddah 39a:14:6.english: Both this and that are forbidden - There is no need to say that the past fifteenth [day] was forbidden, for all day she waited lest she see [an emission], as we hold that a person is obligated to separate from his wife near [the time of] her regular period. And there is no need to say that the twentieth day, on which she saw [an emission], was forbidden, for she is a niddah. Rather, this is what it is saying: When the fifteenth [day] arrives again, she is forbidden to engage in marital relations, for it is the day of her regular period, and as yet she has skipped it only once, and a regular period is not uprooted with fewer than three times. And when the twentieth day arrives from the sighting of the twentieth, she is forbidden to engage in marital relations, lest she establish a regular period from twenty to twenty [days], for she has shifted once to the twentieth day. And similarly, [when it says] twice to the twentieth day, "both this and that are forbidden" — the fifteenth day and the upcoming twentieth day [are forbidden]. But [if she shifted] three times to the twentieth day, the fifteenth day is permitted and the twentieth day is forbidden.

Rashi on Niddah 39a:15:1.hebrew: לא שנו - דליום ט"ו הוי וסת קבוע, דליבעי תלתא זימני למיעקריה:
Rashi on Niddah 39a:15:1.english: They only taught - That for the fifteenth day it is a fixed period, so that it requires three times to uproot it.

Rashi on Niddah 39a:15:2.hebrew: אלא - שהיתה רגילה לראות יום ט"ו לטבילתה לסוף ז' ימי נדה, ורואה ליום ט"ו שהוא יום כ"ב לראייתה, דכבר שלמו ימי זוב לסוף י"ח, והרי ד' ימים שהגיעו ימים שראויה להיות בהם נדה:
Rashi on Niddah 39a:15:2.english: Rather - [That is,] where she was accustomed to see [blood on] the fifteenth day from her immersion at the end of the seven days of niddah, and she sees [blood] on the fifteenth day, which is the twenty-second day from her sighting, for the days of ziva already ended at the end of eighteen [days], and behold, [these are] four days since the days arrived in which she is fit to be a niddah.

Rashi on Niddah 39a:16:1.hebrew: מקבע לא קבעה - בתוך ימי זיבה, דתבעי ג' זימני למיעקריה, דבחדא זימנא הוא דעקר לה; ואם ישבה ולא בדקה, טהורה:
Rashi on Niddah 39a:16:1.english: As for establishing, she does not establish - [A fixed period] during the days of ziva, so that it would require three times to uproot it, for with one time it is uprooted for her; and if she sat and did not examine [herself], she is pure.

Rashi on Niddah 39a:16:2.hebrew: מיחש מהו דניחוש לה - אם היתה רגילה מט"ו לט"ו, דהיינו תוך ימי זוב, מי בעיא למיחש ולא תשמש ליום ט"ו קודם ראייה, שמא תראה:
Rashi on Niddah 39a:16:2.english: As for being concerned, what is [the ruling whether] we should be concerned for her - If she was accustomed [to bleed] every fifteen days, that is, within the days of zivah, is she required to be concerned and not engage in marital relations on the fifteenth day prior to seeing [blood], lest she see [blood]?

Tosafot on Niddah 39a:16:1.hebrew: מקבע לא קבעה ע"י ראייה זו - של תוך ימי זיבה, לא קבעה וסתה שתצטרך לעוקרו על ידי שלש פעמים, כאילו קבעה וסת בימי נדה. אבל מהו שתחוש ע"י קביעות של ימי נדה לאסור פעם רביעי, אפי' בא הוסת בימי זיבה? ואהא מייתי שפיר דחיישינן:
Tosafot on Niddah 39a:16:1.english: [As for] establishing, she does not establish [a cycle] through this sighting - [Through a sighting] within the days of ziva, she does not establish her fixed cycle (veset) such that she would need to uproot it by three times, as if she had established a fixed cycle during the days of niddah. But what is [the ruling as to] whether she must be concerned, by virtue of an establishment [of a cycle] during the days of niddah, to prohibit [intercourse on] a fourth time, even if the [expected time of the] cycle occurs during the days of ziva? And regarding this, [the Gemara] properly brings [proof] that we are concerned.
